verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents programmatic instance lifecycle control through its CLI and REST API, backed by a live OpenAPI spec, and its CLI walkthrough covers renting an instance through to cleaning it up. However, the evidence never shows stop, start, or restart operations specifically, and it says nothing about how billing behaves for stopped versus running instances. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of start/stop/restart/destroy commands or endpoints, billing semantics confirming no compute charges when stopped (and any storage charges), and independent hands-on corroboration of the lifecycle operations.
